accessTokens.forScriptsAndCiAToken: For scripts and CI. A token can do what you can in Supermixer, except change your password, two-factor sign-in, sessions or tokens. Keep them secret like passwords. Changing your password or turning on two-factor sign-in revokes them all.
accessTokens.name: Name
accessTokens.anythingUsingItStopsWorkingStraight: Anything using it stops working straight away. This can't be undone.
accessTokens.itIsnTShownAgainIf: It isn't shown again. If you lose it, revoke it and make another.
accessTokens.giveEachScriptOrServiceIts: Give each script or service its own, so you can revoke one without the others.
accessTokens.whatWillUseItLikeGithub: What will use it, like “GitHub Actions deploys”.
accessTokens.itsApiKeysSecretOnesIf: Its API keys (secret ones if you may see them)
accessTokens.runSqlQueryAnswersWithThe: Run SQL: {"query": "..."}; answers with the rows
accessTokens.edgeFunctionSecretsValuesAsSha: Edge Function secrets (values as SHA-256 digests)
accessTokens.sendTheTokenAsAuthorizationBearer: Send the token as Authorization: Bearer. Requests act as you, with your roles in each organization, and appear in the audit logs with the token's name.
accessTokens.aSubsetOfSupabaseSManagement: A subset of Supabase's Management API (api.supabase.com/v1), with its paths and responses, for scripts written for it. Base URL:
accessTokens.everythingTheAppDoesSuchAs: Everything the app does, such as deploying Edge Functions, backups and Auth settings. Base URL:
accessTokens.describedInOpenapiJsonOpenapi3: Described in openapi.json (OpenAPI 3), for docs viewers and client generators.

appearance.chooseHowSupermixerLooksToYou: Choose how Supermixer looks to you. Your choice is saved on your account, so it follows you to every browser.
appearance.youHavenTChosenATheme: You haven't chosen a theme, so Supermixer uses this server's default: {{value}}.
appearance.setByAppearanceBrandColorIn: Set by appearance.brand_color in the server's .env.toml. Restart Supermixer to apply a change; every shade below is derived from it.

audit.whatYouDidInAnyOrganization: What you did, in any organization, and changes others made to your account. Entries by others don't show their IP address.

me.statusOfThisSupermixerServerAnd: Status of this Supermixer server and its database.
me.usedToSignInItDoes: Used to sign in. It does not change.
me.passwordChangedYourOtherSessionsWere: Password changed; your other sessions were signed out
me.changingItSignsOutYourOther: Changing it signs out your other sessions and revokes your access tokens. Connected sign-in providers (Account › Security) stay connected.
me.anyoneWhoKnowsTheDefaultCan: Anyone who knows the default can sign in as you. Choose a new password now.
me.youAreStillUsingTheDefault: You are still using the default password
me.yourAccountDoesnTHaveA: Your account doesn't have a password. To set one, sign out and use “Forgot your password?” (if Supermixer sends email), or ask an instance admin.
me.youSignInThroughASign: You sign in through a sign-in provider
me.browsersSignedInToYourAccount: Browsers signed in to your account.

security.signInWithACodeFrom: Sign in with a code from an authenticator app (such as 1Password, Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator) as well as your password, so a leaked password alone isn't enough.
security.makeNewOnesBeforeYouRun: Make new ones before you run out.
security.offSomeOrganizationsRequireItYou: Off. Some organizations require it: you can't open them until it's on.
security.twoFactorSignInIsOn: Two-factor sign-in is on; your other sessions were signed out and access tokens revoked
security.ifYouLoseYourPhoneEach: If you lose your phone, each code signs you in once instead of a code from the app. They aren't shown again: keep them somewhere safe, such as your password manager.
security.scanTheQrCodeWithThe: Scan the QR code with the app, or type in the key, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
security.yourAccountSignsInThroughA: Your account signs in through a provider, so a recent sign-in confirms it’s you. Turning it on signs out your other sessions and revokes your access tokens.
security.confirmYourPasswordToStartTurning: Confirm your password to start. Turning it on signs out your other sessions and revokes your access tokens.
security.qrCodeToAddSupermixerTo: QR code to add Supermixer to an authenticator app
security.canTScanItEnterThis: Can't scan it? Enter this key in the app:
security.theOldOnesNoLongerWork: The old ones no longer work. These aren't shown again.
security.yourCurrentRecoveryCodesStopWorking: Your current recovery codes stop working.
security.yourPasswordAloneWillSignYou: Your password alone will sign you in, and your recovery codes stop working. You won't be able to open organizations that require two-factor sign-in.
security.codeFromTheAppOrA: Code from the app, or a recovery code
security.connectYourOrganizationSSignIn: Connect your organization's sign-in to sign in to Supermixer with it. Two-factor sign-in, if it's on, still asks for a code.
security.youCanSignInWithIt: You can sign in with it now.
security.itWillSignYouInTo: It will sign you in to Supermixer. Confirm your password, then sign in to {{name}}.
security.itWonTSignYouIn: It won't sign you in to Supermixer any more. You can connect it again later.
security.onSinceDate: On since {{date}}. Each time you sign in, you'll be asked for a code from the app.
security.onSinceSetup: On since setup. Each time you sign in, you'll be asked for a code from the app.
